plain.text: Across the lake, a man with an evil spirit came out of the tombs to meet Jesus. He lived among the graves, and no chains could hold him. Night and day he cried out and cut himself with stones. He ran and bowed before Jesus. The spirits in him said their name was "Legion", because there were many of them. They begged to be sent into a large herd of pigs nearby. Jesus allowed it, and the herd, about two thousand pigs, rushed into the lake and drowned. People came and found the man sitting there, dressed and in his right mind. They were afraid and asked Jesus to leave. The man wanted to go with Jesus, but Jesus told him, "Go home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you." He did, and people were amazed.

Back across the lake, a synagogue leader named Jairus fell at Jesus' feet. "My little daughter is dying," he pleaded. "Please come and put your hands on her so she will live." Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed.

In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all she had on doctors, but grew worse. She thought, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed." She touched his cloak, and immediately the bleeding stopped. Jesus felt power go out from him and asked, "Who touched my clothes?" Trembling, she told him everything. He said, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."

While Jesus was still speaking, messengers came: "Your daughter is dead. Why bother the teacher?" Jesus told Jairus, "Don't be afraid; just believe." At the house, people were weeping loudly. Jesus said, "The child is not dead but asleep," and they laughed at him. He took her parents and three disciples into the room, took the girl's hand and said, "Talitha koum," which means, "Little girl, get up!" She stood up and walked around. She was twelve years old. Everyone was astonished. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

summary.bigIdea: Jesus has power over evil, sickness and even death, and he cares for each person he meets.
points: Jesus frees a tormented man and sends him home to tell what God has done.
A woman who touches Jesus' cloak in faith is healed and called "daughter".
Jesus raises Jairus's daughter: "Do not be afraid; just believe."
summary.reflection: Jesus stopped in a crowd for one hurting woman. What would you like to bring to him today?
